messages:
mira: Heads up — CI perf suite flagged a 12-18% regression on long-context throughput after today's merge (main@a1b2c3). Repro locally on our runcases that exercise KV eviction. Staging shows increased GPU occupancy and cache thrash.

alex: :eyes: Which merge? Can you link the PR and the CI job?

mira: It's PR #2849 'attn-optimizer: adaptive kernel chooser' (merged ~1h ago). Bisected to that commit. Perf CI job: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/jobs/8793 — diff summary attached in the job artifacts.

jen: Can you paste the microbench command you used? I'll spin up a p4 to repro.

mira: Command I used: `./tools/perf/run_microbench.sh --model llama2-13b --seq 4096 --batch 1 --profile kv_evictions`
Snip from logs:```
[2026-03-18 09:12:05] KVCache: eviction_threshold=0.5 -> evictions=312
[2026-03-18 09:12:05] KVCache: frames_kept=1024 frames_evicted=128 churn=0.11
[2026-03-18 09:12:05] Throughput tokens/sec: 4200 (baseline 5100)
```
The baseline runners show eviction_threshold=0.2 and much lower churn.

sam: Looks like the auto-tuner change bumped the default eviction threshold when it landed. That increases cache churn for long contexts and forces extra kernel work per step. We should revert that change on release branches and backport a hotfix.

alex: Candidate revert PR is up: #2852 "revert: auto-tuner eviction default bump". Can someone run the perf job with that revert on staging?

jen: I'll trigger the perf canary against staging for #2852. `/ci trigger perf-staging PR=2852`

ci-bot: Job queued: perf-staging-2852. Link: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/builds/8850

jen: First run finished: throughput returned to within ~2% of baseline, latency p99 dropped ~9%. Memory per-worker increased slightly (~60MB) on older GPUs. Raw artifacts uploaded to the job.

mira: The memory uptick is expected — reverting restores the prior eviction threshold which keeps more context in cache. We need a backport to release-1.24 and a short verification checklist before rolling. Who can own the cherry-pick?

sam: I'll open a cherry-pick to release-1.24 and add a patch verification checklist (microbench, end-to-end smoke, a staging canary run).

alex: Also let's add a small config gate and unit test to prevent the eviction default from drifting: feature flag `runtime.kv.eviction_override` and a test exercising eviction policy on synthetic workloads.

jen: For rollout I propose: canary 10% for 6 hours with perf tracing enabled. Gate: if p99 tokens latency increases >5% or KV churn >10% compared to canary baseline, rollback. I can own the canary and watch the dashboards.

mira: Please ping @eng-oncall for extra monitoring during rollout.

nora: (eng-oncall) I'll add alerts: `kv_eviction_churn > 10%` and `p99_token_latency_delta > 5%` and a dashboard panel for eviction rate per-model. I'll also watch the first hour.

sam: Backport plan notes: `git checkout release-1.24 && git cherry-pick -x a1b2c3` then open PR with perf diffs attached. I'll also run `./tools/perf/kv_sim.py --seed 42 --seq-dist heavy` to validate edgecases.

alex: Good. Also run the CI microbench harness with `--repeat 10` to get stable numbers.

mira: Owners and timeline: backport=Sam (PR by EOD), perf canary run=Jen (in ~2h), monitoring=Nora, patch review=Alex. If canary looks good we can schedule a staged rollout tomorrow morning.

jen: Ack. I'll add the rollback playbook to the canary run notes and update release notes: "fix: revert eviction threshold bump causing throughput regression for long-context workloads"

sam: Backport PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2860. Linking artifacts and perf comparisons. CC @mira @jen @alex

jen: LGTM, merging to release-1.24; starting staging verification now.

ci-bot: Patch verified in staging. Canary gate checks passed for basic smoke tests.

mira: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with a short postmortem capturing root cause: auto-tuner bumped eviction default without per-model guard and no perf gate for long-context workloads. Postmortem + lessons will be in #postmortems later today.
